title: What does the term Sangam refer to?
description: In ancient Tamil history, what does the term Sangam traditionally refer to?
hint: It refers to assemblies of Tamil poets and scholars.
summary: Sangam refers to traditional assemblies of Tamil poets and scholars.

options.title: Assemblies of Tamil poets and scholars

title: Which language dominates Sangam literature?
description: Which language was the principal language of Sangam literature?
hint: It is a major Dravidian language of South India.
summary: Tamil is the principal language of Sangam literature.

title: Which three dynasties dominated the Sangam age?
description: Which three Tamil dynasties are traditionally associated with the Sangam period?
hint: They were major powers of ancient Tamilakam.
summary: The Cheras, Cholas and Pandyas were the three major dynasties of the Sangam age.

title: What was the ancient Tamil region called?
description: What name is commonly used for the ancient Tamil-speaking region during the Sangam period?
hint: The term literally refers to the Tamil country.
summary: Tamilakam refers to the ancient Tamil country.

title: Which dynasty ruled the western part of ancient Tamilakam?
description: Which Sangam dynasty was mainly associated with the western part of Tamilakam?
hint: Its rulers were associated with the region around present-day Kerala.
summary: The Cheras were mainly associated with the western part of ancient Tamilakam.

title: What was the emblem of the Cheras?
description: Which symbol is traditionally associated with the Chera dynasty?
hint: It is an animal associated with strength.
summary: The bow and arrow were important symbols associated with the Cheras.

title: Which dynasty was associated with the Kaveri delta?
description: Which Sangam dynasty controlled the fertile Kaveri delta region?
hint: Its emblem was the tiger.
summary: The Cholas were associated with the Kaveri delta.

title: What was the emblem of the Cholas?
description: Which animal was the traditional emblem of the Chola dynasty?
hint: It is a large carnivorous animal.
summary: The tiger was the emblem of the Cholas.

title: What was the emblem of the Pandyas?
description: Which symbol was associated with the Pandya dynasty?
hint: It is an aquatic animal.
summary: The fish was the emblem of the Pandyas.

title: Which city was an important Pandya capital?
description: Which city served as the principal capital of the Pandyas during the Sangam age?
hint: It is one of the oldest cities in Tamil Nadu.
summary: Madurai was the principal Pandya capital.

title: Which city was an important early Chola center?
description: Which city was an important early Chola capital during the Sangam period?
hint: It was located in the Kaveri region.
summary: Uraiyur was an important early Chola center.

title: Which port was associated with the early Cholas?
description: Which important port city was associated with the Cholas during the Sangam period?
hint: It was located near the mouth of the Kaveri.
summary: Kaveripattinam, also called Puhar, was an important Chola port.

title: Which port was associated with the Pandyas?
description: Which ancient port was an important center of Pandya trade?
hint: It was located in the southern part of Tamil Nadu.
summary: Korkai was an important Pandya port and a center of pearl fishing.

title: Which port was an important Chera trade center?
description: Which ancient port is strongly associated with Chera trade and Roman commerce?
hint: It is identified with a site near the Periyar region.
summary: Muziris was an important Chera trade center associated with Roman commerce.

title: Which Roman work mentions Muziris?
description: Which ancient Greco-Roman geographical work provides information about ports such as Muziris?
hint: It was a first-century work describing navigation and trade routes.
summary: The Periplus of the Erythraean Sea mentions Muziris.

title: What was Korkai famous for?
description: What economic activity was Korkai especially famous for during the Sangam period?
hint: The Gulf of Mannar was famous for this marine resource.
summary: Korkai was famous for pearl fishing and the pearl trade.

title: Which foreign traders had extensive contact with Sangam Tamilakam?
description: Which Mediterranean people were important trading partners of the Tamil kingdoms?
hint: Their coins have been found in South India.
summary: Roman traders had extensive commercial contact with Sangam Tamilakam.

title: Which Roman coins have been found in Tamil Nadu?
description: Archaeological discoveries in Tamil Nadu provide evidence of trade with Rome through the presence of which objects?
hint: They were used as currency in the Roman world.
summary: Roman gold and silver coins have been found in parts of Tamil Nadu.

title: Which text is an important source for Sangam history?
description: Which collection of ancient Tamil poems is an important source for reconstructing Sangam society?
hint: Its name means 'Eight Anthologies'.
summary: Ettuthokai, or the Eight Anthologies, is a major source of Sangam literature.

title: What does Pattuppattu mean?
description: What does the Tamil literary collection Pattuppattu literally mean?
hint: The name refers to a number of poems.
summary: Pattuppattu means the Ten Idylls.

title: Which work is considered the earliest extant Tamil grammatical text?
description: Which ancient Tamil work deals extensively with grammar and poetics?
hint: Its name begins with 'Tolk'.
summary: Tolkappiyam is the earliest extant Tamil grammatical text.

title: Which text describes the ancient Tamil landscape system?
description: Which Sangam literary tradition classified landscapes into categories such as Kurinji and Mullai?
hint: It is closely connected with the study of Tamil grammar and poetics.
summary: Tolkappiyam describes the classification of landscapes in Tamil literary tradition.

title: Which Sangam landscape represented the mountains?
description: In the traditional Sangam classification of landscapes, which landscape represented mountainous regions?
hint: Its name is associated with hills and mountain areas.
summary: Kurinji represented the mountainous landscape.

title: Which Sangam landscape represented the pastoral region?
description: Which landscape represented forests and pastoral areas in Sangam literature?
hint: It is associated with pastoral life and cattle herding.
summary: Mullai represented the pastoral and forest landscape.

title: Which Sangam landscape represented agricultural plains?
description: Which landscape represented fertile agricultural and riverine plains?
hint: It was associated with farming and settled villages.
summary: Marutham represented the agricultural plains.

title: Which Sangam landscape represented the seashore?
description: Which landscape was associated with the coast and maritime activities?
hint: Its people were traditionally connected with fishing and the sea.
summary: Neythal represented the seashore and coastal landscape.

title: Which Sangam landscape represented arid terrain?
description: Which landscape represented dry or arid conditions in Sangam literary classification?
hint: It is associated with hardship and journeys.
summary: Palai represented the arid or dry landscape.

title: Which Sangam work is part of the Eight Anthologies?
description: Which of the following works belongs to Ettuthokai?
hint: It is one of the famous anthologies of Sangam poetry.
summary: Purananuru is one of the works included in Ettuthokai.

title: Which Sangam work focuses heavily on love poetry?
description: Which anthology is particularly associated with poems dealing with themes of love?
hint: Its name refers to internal or subjective themes.
summary: Akananuru focuses primarily on love and inner-life themes.

title: Which Sangam work focuses on public life and warfare?
description: Which anthology mainly contains poems dealing with kings, warfare, generosity and public life?
hint: Its name contrasts with Akananuru.
summary: Purananuru deals extensively with public life, warfare and kingship.

title: Who was Senguttuvan?
description: Senguttuvan was a famous ruler of which Sangam dynasty?
hint: He is associated with the Chera kingdom.
summary: Senguttuvan was a famous Chera ruler.

title: Which epic is associated with Senguttuvan?
description: Which Tamil epic describes the story connected with the Chera ruler Senguttuvan?
hint: The epic is associated with Kannagi.
summary: Silappadikaram is associated with Senguttuvan and the story of Kannagi.

title: Who wrote Silappadikaram?
description: Who is traditionally credited with composing the Tamil epic Silappadikaram?
hint: He is traditionally described as a Jain prince or ascetic.
summary: Ilango Adigal is traditionally credited with Silappadikaram.

title: Who wrote Manimekalai?
description: Which author is traditionally credited with the Tamil epic Manimekalai?
hint: He is also known as Chithalai Chathanar.
summary: Sattanar is traditionally credited with Manimekalai.

title: Which text gives information about the port city of Puhar?
description: Which Sangam poem provides a detailed description of the Chola port city of Puhar?
hint: The title contains the word 'Pattin'.
summary: Pattinappalai provides information about Puhar and Chola trade.

title: Which Sangam ruler is associated with the Battle of Venni?
description: Which early Chola ruler is famous for his victory at the Battle of Venni?
hint: He is one of the most celebrated early Chola rulers.
summary: Karikala Chola is associated with the Battle of Venni.

title: Which major irrigation work is traditionally attributed to Karikala Chola?
description: Which ancient structure on the Kaveri is traditionally attributed to Karikala Chola?
hint: It is one of the oldest water-regulation structures in India.
summary: The Kallanai, or Grand Anicut, is traditionally attributed to Karikala Chola.

title: What was an important occupation in Sangam society?
description: Which occupation formed an important part of the economy of the Sangam period?
hint: The fertile plains supported this activity.
summary: Agriculture was an important occupation in Sangam society.

title: Which crop was especially important in the Sangam economy?
description: Which crop was an important agricultural product in the fertile regions of ancient Tamilakam?
hint: It is a major staple food crop.
summary: Rice was an important agricultural crop in Sangam Tamilakam.

title: Which animal product was important in Sangam trade?
description: Which valuable animal-derived product was associated with the pearl and maritime trade of ancient Tamilakam?
hint: It was obtained from the sea rather than land animals.
summary: Pearls were an important valuable commodity in Sangam trade.

title: Which Roman product was imported into Sangam Tamilakam?
description: Which type of Roman goods is mentioned in evidence relating to trade with ancient Tamilakam?
hint: They were luxury items associated with Roman commerce.
summary: Roman wine was an important imported commodity in Indo-Roman trade.

title: Which occupation was associated with the Neythal landscape?
description: Which activity was particularly associated with the coastal Neythal landscape?
hint: The landscape is connected with the sea.
summary: Fishing was an important occupation associated with the Neythal landscape.

title: Which occupation was associated with the Kurinji landscape?
description: Which activity was traditionally associated with the mountainous Kurinji landscape?
hint: Think of forest and hill communities.
summary: Hunting was an important activity associated with the Kurinji landscape.

title: Which occupation was associated with the Mullai landscape?
description: Which economic activity was traditionally associated with the Mullai landscape?
hint: It involved herding cattle.
summary: Cattle herding and pastoralism were associated with the Mullai landscape.

title: Which occupation was associated with the Marutham landscape?
description: Which economic activity was especially associated with the fertile Marutham plains?
hint: The landscape had fertile agricultural fields.
summary: Agriculture, especially wet-rice cultivation, was associated with Marutham.

title: Which ancient Tamil text contains moral teachings?
description: Which famous Tamil work contains concise couplets on ethics, wealth and love?
hint: It is attributed to Tiruvalluvar.
summary: Tirukkural, attributed to Tiruvalluvar, contains teachings on ethics, wealth and love.

title: Who is traditionally credited with Tirukkural?
description: Who is traditionally regarded as the author of the Tirukkural?
hint: He is one of the most celebrated Tamil ethical poets.
summary: Tiruvalluvar is traditionally credited with composing the Tirukkural.

title: What was an important feature of Sangam society?
description: Which statement best describes an important feature of Sangam-age society?
hint: Literature provides information about different social groups and occupations.
summary: Sangam literature provides evidence of a society with diverse occupations, social groups and economic activities.

options.title: A society with diverse occupations and social groups
A society based only on hunting

title: Which source provides evidence of Indo-Roman trade in South India?
description: Which archaeological site in Tamil Nadu provides evidence of Roman trade and Mediterranean contacts?
hint: It is an ancient settlement near present-day Puducherry.
summary: Arikamedu provides important archaeological evidence of Indo-Roman trade.

title: Which statement best describes Sangam literature?
description: What makes Sangam literature especially valuable for historians?
hint: It provides information about ancient Tamil society.
summary: Sangam literature provides valuable information about the political, social, economic and cultural life of ancient Tamilakam.

options.title: It provides information about ancient Tamil political, social and economic life
It was written entirely during the Mughal period
